The '''Viraanntesse system''' was located in the [[Dona Laza sector/Legends|Dona Laza sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Viraanntesse]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Viraanntesse [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-9.<ref name="TEA" />
